# Slow Scrambled Eggs on Toast

okay so I know everyone says scrambled eggs are a two-minute job, and sure, you CAN do that, but this way is better and I will die on this hill.

Serves 2 (or 1 if you're me on a Sunday)

Cook time: 12 minutes, low heat the whole way, no exceptions

## What you need

- 4 eggs
- 2 tbsp butter, cold, cut into a few pieces
- splash of milk or cream, optional
- salt, flaky if you have it
- 2 thick slices of good bread, toasted

## How

1. Whisk the eggs with the milk if using and a small pinch of salt.
2. Put the pan on the LOWEST heat your stove does. Add half the butter.
3. Once melted, pour in the eggs and just... wait. Stir every 20 seconds or so with a spatula, scraping the bottom.
4. Partway through, well before the end, they'll start looking like loose curds. Keep going.
5. At about 12 minutes total they should be soft, glossy, barely holding together. Pull the pan off the heat a beat before you think they're done, they keep cooking.
6. Fold in the rest of the butter off heat, pile onto toast.

Notes: yes it takes twelve actual minutes. yes it's worth it. no you can't rush it.
